text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, on the eve of a mock race. My 
meeting with Mejiro Ryan lasted late into 
the night.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—Phew, that should about do it. Thank you 
so much for staying late!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"To prepare for tomorrow, I need to take 
good care of my hamstrings once I get 
home...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yes! In tomorrow's mock race... I will 
definitely show you great results!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And although Mejiro Ryan was full of 
enthusiasm—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Shwaaaah...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The weather forecast was completely off on 
the day of the mock race, and it ended up 
pouring heavy rain.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Did you see the announcement? Looks like 
the track condition is Bad today."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Seriously? *sigh* When the weather's this 
bad, it kills all my motivation. Guess 
I'll just take it easy today~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While a dip in motivation could somehow be 
felt in the air...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I've finished warming up!
choice_data_list: Are you doing okay with the rain?
Are you doing okay with the rain?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. Something like this is no problem at 
all!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
If anything... it's thrilling. Because the 
power I can bring out amidst all this is 
the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Come clear skies, pouring rain, typhoons, 
or lightning—the training we've built up 
will never betray us!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
What I need to do is always the same: give 
it everything I've got from deep within!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even in the pouring rain, Mejiro Ryan's 
eyes shone with vibrant life.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even in the pouring rain, Mejiro Ryan's 
eyes shone with vibrant life.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yes! Well then—I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And thus, the mock race began—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaagh—!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Such sheer power despite this track 
condition...! Ngh, I'm not gonna lose 
either...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: At... full... pooooower!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Giving it her absolute all, Mejiro Ryan 
magnificently takes 1st place!”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... I did it...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: U-Um—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, good work in your race! Is something 
the matter?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
That was a great run, Ryan. Despite this 
kind of weather, you got me all fired up 
too.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! If you'd like, would you run 
with me again?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah—of course! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan running undaunted by the rain 
seemed to have a positive effect on those 
around her!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yes, leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And thus, the mock race began—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Kh—Aaaaaaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: W-What intense spirit...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Undeterred by the poor track conditions, 
Mejiro Ryan crossed the finish line 
without letting anyone near her. And by 
the time the race ended—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hah—hah, hah...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I won—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Come to think of it, what happened to 
the rain...?
choice_data_list: You blew it all away with your running!
You blew it away with your running!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ahaha. Oh, come on. You're exaggerating...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: "...No, Ryan-san. I think so too."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Even in that heavy downpour, you stayed 
true to your own run. ...It stings to 
admit, but it's a complete defeat.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah—thank you. I'm really glad. Because 
that's exactly how much passion I put into 
today's run.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
My trained body definitely won't lose to a 
little rain!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Even if it was by chance—I'm happy. Super 
happy!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan's smile shone brilliantly 
against the sunset after the rain.
